error: Driver ARG is considered for removal in GDAL 3.9. You are invited to convert any dataset in that format to another more common one. If you need this driver in future GDAL versions, create a ticket at https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal (look first for an existing one first) to explain how critical it is for you (but the GDAL project may still remove it), and to enable it now, set the GDAL_ENABLE_DEPRECATED_DRIVER_ARG configuration option / environment variable to YES.
